problems: No merger of this fund is described in any excerpt. The N-14 8C and N-14 8C/A filings (seq 4, 13, 15, 16, 27, 30) are registration statements for exchange offers of registered notes for restricted notes (for example 'In the exchange offer, we will exchange 2023 Restricted Notes and 2026 Restricted Notes for a like principal amount of the 2023 Exchange Notes and 2026 Exchange Notes'), not fund mergers. The 8-Ks cover note offerings, a name change, distributions, NAV, officer and trustee appointments, an IPO notice (seq 22) and quarterly results (the fund is shown as NYSE: BXSL from seq 24 on). No acquirer or target fund, merger agreement, vote or outcome appears.
